name: Shipping chokepoints
value: Hormuz largely shut; record Oct attacks
summary: Hormuz largely shut; tanker hit off Oman and dhow struck on 3 Nov
state: UKMTO recorded a record 30 attacks on commercial ships in October (CBS). On 3 Nov an Indian dhow was struck off Oman, killing one crew member (CBS), and UKMTO reported a tanker hit by two projectiles near Lima, Oman (SBS). Iran says Hormuz will reopen only when its conditions, including lifting the US blockade, are met.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for the Gulf. Shipping disruption raises delivery times and costs for imported goods.

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates
SBS News — Iran says 'long way to go' until end of war

why: Around 30% of seaborne oil and much container trade passes Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb/Suez, Panama and Malacca; disruption raises prices worldwide.
drivers: Houthi/Iran attacks, war-risk insurance, drought (Panama), naval incidents, piracy.

rubric.alert: Hormuz traffic materially impeded, or any chokepoint closed, or two or more disrupted at once.
rubric.watch: One chokepoint disrupted (attacks, large-scale diversions, draught restrictions).
